g.text: UC-12 - Persist and Manage Blocking Rules (planned FST-048)
V5 creates policy/rule tables and constraints
query rules with target and audit fields
save a rule or toggle enabled
validate JSON object, fields and target shape
persist changed rows, keys and audit fields
CORS and Tauri must permit PATCH while preserving
PATCH keeps omitted fields and replaces a provided target whole.
Every writer locks before loading, including delete-all.
UNIQUE(policy_id, target_key) backs domain duplicate validation.
No request-time lazy policy insertion; no lost aggregate updates.
Rule CRUD saves configuration, not enforcement success.
Detection, browser support and OS blocking are follow-on stories.
